spans.s:
mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं)
Lame, crippled, limping.
f. (-ञ्जा)
A species of metre, a stanza of two lines, one of thirty-two, the other of thirty feet.
E.
खजि to limp or go lame, affix अच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Lame, limping.
E.
खजि to limp, affix वुन्.

m. (-टः)
A wag-tail.
E.
खञ्ज lame, and खेट who moves.

m. (-लः)
A wag-tail.
E.
खञ्ज lame, and खेल who moves, from खेल to move, affix अच्.

m. (-नः)
A small bird, the wag-tail, (Motacilla alba.)
f. (-ना)
1 A small kind of wag-tail.
2 Mustard.
n. (-र्नं)
Going, moving.
E.
खजि to go lamely, affix ल्यु.

n. (-तं)
The cohabitation of saints.
E.
खञ्जन a wag-tail, and रत cohabitation.

m. (-टः)
A wag-tail.
E.
खञ्ज lame, ऋ to go, कीटन् affix, deriv. irr.
